title: You Don't Need Everything on Your Resume
description:
What should actually go on your resume? Only. Relevant. Information. Your resume isn’t a “catch all” with every job you’ve had. If something isn’t relevant or can’t BE relevant by listing your achievements in a relevant way take it off. #resumetips #resumeadvice #resumewriting #resumetok #resumetiktok #jobseeker #jobseekers
